mapper.sql: COUNT(*) > COUNT(DISTINCT pa.item_id) OR COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(pa.created_at)) > 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalAttempts, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.exercise_id) AS practicedExercises, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.active=TRUE THEN pa.exercise_id END) AS practicedActiveExercises, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(pa.created_at)) AS practiceDays, COALESCE(SUM(pa.attempt_type='HOMEWORK'),0) AS homeworkAttempts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT pa.exercise_id FROM practice_attempts pa WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} GROUP BY pa.exercise_id HAVING ) r) AS retriedExercises, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(pa.created_at),'%Y-%m-%d') AS firstPracticedOn, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(pa.created_at),'%Y-%m-%d') AS lastPracticedOn FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId}

SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId,c.name, COALESCE(a.attempts,0) AS attempts,COALESCE(a.practicedExercises,0) AS practicedExercises, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exercises x WHERE x.category_id=c.category_id AND x.active=TRUE) AS totalExercises FROM practice_categories c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT e.category_id,COUNT(*) AS attempts,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.active=TRUE THEN pa.exercise_id END) AS practicedExercises FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} GROUP BY e.category_id ) a ON a.category_id=c.category_id WHERE c.active=TRUE ORDER BY c.sort_order

SELECT pa.exercise_id AS exerciseId,e.title,e.category_id AS categoryId,c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS attempts,COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(pa.created_at)) AS days, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(pa.created_at),'%Y-%m-%d') AS lastPracticedOn FROM practice_attempts pa JOIN exercises e ON e.exercise_id=pa.exercise_id JOIN practice_categories c ON c.category_id=e.category_id WHERE pa.student_id=#{studentId} GROUP BY pa.exercise_id,e.title,e.category_id,c.name HAVING ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,MAX(pa.created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exercises WHERE active=TRUE
